title: FSH Treatment for Non-obstructive Azoospermic Patients
brief_summary: Aim of the study is to evaluate the effect of highly purified human follicle-stimulating hormone treatment on the chance of retrieving testicular sperm (sperm retrieval rate) from infertile male patients with non-obstructive azoospermia of unknown origin.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Azoospermia;
* testis longitudinal axis less than 4.5 cm;
* serum follicle-stimulating hormone greater than 7.6 IU/L

Exclusion Criteria:

* History of testicular biopsy,
* malignancy,
* varicocele,
* hyperprolactinemia,
* thyroid disfunction,
* chemotherapy,
* radiotherapy
